record.doc_number_verbatim: MOFCOM, MIIT, GACC and SCA Announcement No. 51 (2024)
record.title: Announcement issuing the Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China
record.issuer: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM); Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT); General Administration of Customs (GACC); State Cryptography Administration (SCA)
record.relation_note: The unified list system consolidates roughly 700 previously controlled items (10 major industry sectors x 5 item-type codes); 11 legacy announcements were repealed on the same day, and the commercial-cryptography list content no longer applies
record.note: Original text on the China Export Control website (MOFCOM).
